Note from Centre President

Dr. Prince K. Osei

You are welcome to AIMS Ghana, the third Centre of Excellence under the Next Einstein Initiative established in 2012. We extend a particularly warm welcome to those joining us from countries other than Ghana and for whom this is your first time here. We are confident that your time here will be rewarding and enjoyable.

As the President of the AIMS Ghana Centre, it is a delight to share with you the vision and mission of this institution. Our vision is to lead the transformation of Africa through innovative scientific training, technical advances and breakthrough discoveries. We are also on a mission to enable Africa’s brightest students to flourish as independent thinkers, problem solvers and innovators capable of propelling Africa’s future scientific, educational and economic self-sufficiency.

Academic excellence is sought all round, using the best curriculum to meet the fast-changing demands of our global system. Our strength lies in a great team of highly qualified board members, management, lecturers and tutors in order to deliver a first-class educational structure.

Here at AIMS, we believe that in order to succeed, you should be willing and able, to keep a positive attitude, have good time management skills; and be unafraid to take initiatives. We are indeed happy with our accomplishments so far; however, we aspire to emerge as the world’s most prominent institution in STEM.

Thank you for joining us and we invite you to get interactive!
